prior_exposure: All earlier test summaries were observed. This supplement is exploratory, not preregistered confirmation. Independent confirmatory data are not yet secured.
original_primary_endpoint: signed response MAE, equal target within context then equal context within donor then equal donor; retain old FV-versus-concat P2 contrast and original results

label_spaces.pooled: published DESeq2 log2FC, published fixed gene universe; inherited feature-curation limitations disclosed
label_spaces.donor: delta_log2(1+CPM), normalization over original 18129 features, fixed donor_genes.csv; no cross-unit pooling
label_spaces.missingness: true observed mask only; zeros are actual values, unknown labels not zero; no effect/significance filtering

P0.allowed: fixed target function annotations and literal context metadata
P0.strict_training: held validation/test target outcomes removed in all contexts

P1.allowed: P0 plus allowed NTC profiles; no direct held-target response evidence

P2.allowed: P1 plus same-target response in other training contexts, only frozen evidence_only/train pool

permissions.global_unseen_target: P0/P1 only; no same-target response in any source, teacher or auxiliary corpus
permissions.same_context_other_perturbations: permitted only when that context belongs to training; for an unseen context no perturbation outcomes are allowed
permissions.extra_knowledge: function annotations separate from measured DepMap/L1000/etc.; any added measured-response source becomes a different information stratum

matched_comparisons.name: strict information access
matched_comparisons.equal: supervised labels, tests, gene list, search budget; only declared response access differs

matched_comparisons.name: hierarchical component
matched_comparisons.equal: own originally selected warm-start plus <=1000 corrective steps; frozen selections; no retuning
matched_comparisons.limitation: warm-start histories and wall time reported; older 3000-step models are not equal-compute continuation controls

matched_comparisons.name: simple baseline check
matched_comparisons.equal: identical evaluable rows and genes; additive must have required support; no global-unseen P2 fallback disguised as true same-target evidence

new_selection_budget.checkpoint_selection: reuse existing validation-selected frozen checkpoints; no test-based switches

supplemental_metrics.rule: within condition, across fixed genes; center both vectors; zero norm -> NA; report NA count; equal donor/context/target summary
dot(pred,true)/dot(true,true); denominator<=1e-12 -> NA; diagnostic, not mechanism evidence
evaluate abs(true)>0.1 in label-specific log2 units; report denominator and coverage; predicted zero counts as incorrect
pooled published adjp<0.05 and abs(log2FC)>0.5; score abs(pred); report AP prevalence and no-positive exclusions; no donor DE labels invented

within same donor/context and fixed test panel; cosine of raw delta vector; correct-target rank against all panel targets; average tied rank; normalized inverse rank=(N-rank)/(N-1); invalid zero vector -> NA; report N and exclusions

seen-target transfer only: subtract same frozen training-only target shared reference from prediction/truth; unavailable references -> NA; equal donor/context/target summary; do not call this replicate-adjusted CGC recovery
reuse all fixed IL10/IL21 x three RNA contexts, 9 targets, extra-donor same-study panel; no selecting best context; no independent-study claim

positive_controls.role: metric diagnostic only; target-condition outcomes never enter learned predictions or selection
positive_controls.construction: donor-response space only: split targeting guides and NTC guides deterministically into disjoint halves within donor/culture/run using SHA256(prefix|guide); aggregate each half with equal-guide weights after original per-row count QC and log2(1+CPM); use replicate-disjoint controls where present
positive_controls.eligibility: at least 2 distinct targeting guides and 2 distinct matched NTC guides with eligible rows; all relevant blocks nonempty; report exclusions and exact intersection
positive_controls.fallback: if guide/NTC/replicate metadata do not support independence, mark biological positive control unavailable; never substitute y for its own prediction
positive_controls.comparison: score zero, training mean, target mean when permitted and positive control on same eligible panel; no retuning gene weights on test
positive_controls.DRF: only if denominator nonzero and metric directions oriented identically; diagnostic on available positive/negative controls, not clinical calibration
positive_controls.oracle: an exact-truth oracle may be used for software bounds only, never as biological positive control or reported model

negative_controls.wrong_target: 20 fixed within-donor/context target derangements, seeded 20261026; reassignment of frozen predictions; no realignment to improve outcomes; aggregation over common supported test panel
negative_controls.wrong_context: seen-target cross-context derangement only when all candidate contexts have matched support; report blocked cases
negative_controls.role: diagnose perturbation/context correspondence; not substitutes for strongest predictive baseline

statistics.units: donor is independent biological unit for donor tasks; targets/genes/seeds are not substitute donors; pooled task has no donor generalization CI
statistics.seed_summary: first average each metric across three trained seeds, then compare four held donors; keep seed SD separately
statistics.four_donor: show all four paired differences and mean; 10000-draw donor bootstrap and 16 sign patterns descriptive only because n=4, sign symmetry and overlapping CV fits
statistics.multiplicity: fixed family: hierarchy vs continued FV, fixed Gaussian, unshrunk offsets, on MAE and Pearson (6 exploratory contrasts); Holm across all six, retain raw p; no confirmatory significance claim
statistics.replicates: guide/run/plate splits constrain truth reliability; report repeated measurements nested in donors
statistics.confidence_not_posterior: Gaussian regularization is MAP-like, not full posterior; empirical calibration has no OOD exchangeability guarantee

independent_confirmation_gate.current_status: unmet for harmonized independent primary-T CRISPRi
independent_confirmation_gate.requirements: new study, resolved donor/time/intervention/control, full response genes or raw counts, deduplicated subjects/assays, no use for model or metric selection
independent_confirmation_gate.exclusions: same-study flow is independent assay/donors, not independent study; cancer line transfer is OOD check, not independent primary-T confirmation; KO and CRISPRi cannot silently be treated as identical
independent_confirmation_gate.timebox: metadata feasibility decision by 2026-10-28 18:00+08:00; otherwise scope limitation and no new mass download

completion_boundary: This freezes protocol and verifies existing manifests only. No new positive-control biological result, new modern-baseline run, or independent-study replication is declared complete.
do_not_modify: old source folders, frozen split files, old outcomes/checkpoints, Digital_Organ_Twin, retained documents, old submission baseline
